en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazal, from Ibn Bukeyr, from Zurara, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> in a Hadeeth of Bureyra,
that the Prophet<sup>saww</sup> said to Ayesha: ‘Emancipate (a slave) for the guardianship is for the one who emancipates’.
en.sarwar: 2. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn Faddal from ibn Bukayr from Zurarah who has narrated the following: “Abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about Hadith of Burayrah

has said, ‘The Holy Prophet, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, said to ‘A’ishah, ‘Set a slave free because guardianship rests with the one who buys one’s freedom.’”
